result: Multi-agent features exist in multi_agent.py but are NOT wired into the API. Findings: (1) MultiAgentOrchestrator, SequentialPipeline, ParallelExecutor, and create_multi_agent_chain() exist in multi_agent.py but have zero usage across the codebase. (2) There are NO database models for multi-agent workflows (no AgentWorkflow, Pipeline, etc.). (3) There are NO serializers for multi-agent features. (4) There are NO API views or endpoints for multi-agent orchestration. (5) The multi_agent.py file defines abstract classes (BaseAgent, AgentRole, AgentMessage, TaskResult) and utility classes that are not integrated with the existing Agent model. Recommendation: Mark multi-agent as an experimental feature with documentation. Full integration would require: (a) new database models for workflows/pipelines, (b) new serializers, (c) new API views/endpoints, (d) integration with the existing Agent model via MultiAgentWrapper. Current state: multi_agent.py is standalone infrastructure not connected to the Django app's API layer.

questions_answered.verdict: Experimental/incomplete feature - not wired, recommend documentation not removal
